sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2
sources.license: Copernicus Open Access Policy (Free, full and open)

sources.name: ESA WorldCover 2021
sources.desc: Global 10m land cover map based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data, utilized as an independent macroscopic calibration benchmark.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.desc: Cartographic vector tiles, road networks, municipal boundaries, and reference base map features.

sources.name: Earth Search STAC API
